notes: Seed URL works. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Election-night results are on a livevoterturnout.com ENR site linked from the county page wp-content/enr/ ('Unofficial Election Day results from polling locations will be updated throughout the night'); for the May 26, 2026 runoff the links are ENR IDs 43 (Republican) and 44 (Democratic). The ENR shows only the final state ('Website Updated: 5/26/2026 10:02:55 PM'), with no readable update history, and breaks results down by vote center ('precinctLabel = "Vote Centers"', 'Total Precincts 32' relabeled 'Total Vote Centers'), not by election precinct. Precinct-by-precinct reports are posted on the county Results page only after canvass (runoff files in wp-content/uploads/2026/06; primary 'Precinct Result 031126'). The ENR IDs for the 2026 primary and 2024 general are no longer linked and were not probed; check 3 pending for those (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: Only the 2026 runoff is determined (LATER: election-night results by vote center and county totals, precinct-by-precinct reports only after canvass), so by rule the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with confidence low.

2024_general.fact: Election-night ENR link for the 2024 general is no longer on the county site; Results page holds post-canvass reports. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: Election-night ENR link for the primary is no longer on the county site; Results page holds Summary 'Final' and 'Precinct by Precinct' reports dated 03/11/2026 (Democrat-Party-Precinct-Result-031126.pdf). Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: ENR 'Cameron County, TX Elections Department May 26, 2026 Republican Primary Runoff ... Unofficial Election Results ... Vote Centers Reporting 100% ... Fully Reporting 32 Total Precincts 32', 'Website Updated: 5/26/2026 10:02:55 PM', Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 03:02:55 GMT; drill-down label 'Vote Centers Results'. Precinct-by-precinct reports ('Primary-Runoff-Democratic-Precinct-052626.pdf', 'Republican-sigined-precinct-by-precinct-report001.pdf') are uploaded in June 2026.
